entities.title: Choose entities to relay
entities.description: Select up to {limit} entities. This syncs the selected list to your service account. Locks and covers remain read-only unless explicitly enabled in that account; scripts can run wider local actions.

reauth_confirm.title: Update your connection key
reauth_confirm.description: Paste the replacement key for this same connection from your service account.

automatic.title: Use the automatic entity picker
automatic.description: Paste your relay token and choose entities. This mode sends and receives automatically. Do not also run a relay UI automation or YAML package for this connection.

user.title: How would you like to connect?

error.invalid_auth: The relay token is invalid, revoked, disabled, or no longer licensed.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach myhomeassistant.top. Check that Home Assistant can connect to the internet.
error.rate_limited: The service asked this client to wait. Try again later and check for another client using the same license.
error.entity_limit: Choose at least one entity within your current plan's limit.

abort.already_configured: This relay license already has an integration entry.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Use a token for the same license.
abort.reauth_successful: The relay token has been updated.

init.title: Edit selected relay entities
init.description: Changes sync to the service. Removed entities stop being shared; sensitive permissions can only be granted in your service account. Keep the selected list within your plan allowance.

automation.title: Relay UI automation helper
automation.description: Update your token and selected entities in the relay automation under Settings → Automations. Save the automation to apply changes; this helper sends no background requests.

error.invalid_auth: Replace the relay token using reauthentication.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the relay service.
error.rate_limited: Wait before editing again; the service limits configuration requests.
error.entity_limit: Choose at least one entity within your current plan's limit.

sync.name: Send states and collect controls
sync.description: Use a UI automation to share the selected entity states and collect queued controls over outbound HTTPS. Add the Relay UI automation helper first. Keep the token private.

token.name: Relay token
token.description: The current private token from your myhomeassistant.top account.

entity_ids.name: Selected entities
entity_ids.description: The same selected entity list shown in your relay account.

poll_commands.name: Collect controls
poll_commands.description: Leave on for scheduled updates; turn off for device-change updates to preserve the command-pull allowance.
